title: What the Fed *JUST* Warned
speaker: Kevin Paffrath

macro_themes.view: Hawkish headline but participants stressed data dependence; strong PDFP/AI capex economy, equity gains fully earnings-driven with falling P/Es.
Markets price ~84% odds of one more hike by December; he thinks a real chance there is no second hike. Oct 14 and Nov 10 CPI reports are key.
Labor-force participation normalising could push unemployment up — a red flag, but at least ~6 months away.
Credit broadly available; Oura's shelved IPO is idiosyncratic, not a liquidity problem.

calls.reason: Economy booming on AI capex, earnings rising faster than prices so stocks getting cheaper; hikes may not be needed if Iran war ends / CPI behaves.
calls.quote: I think Jerome Powell just sent us a big signal that the moon is coming, boys and girls.

notes: No explicit date spoken; FOMC minutes released 'just' → same day as the minutes, 2026-10-07 (the StockedUp video eCJholxYeZE dates the minutes to Wed 10-07). Listing said 10-08 (20 hours ago). Recorded_when inferred after the 2 pm ET minutes release. Video type: macro commentary, no guest.
